notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); NBIM's separate row for Qnity Electronics Inc (the November 2025 spin-off) is not counted. CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. DuPont's CUSIP changed from 26614N102 to 26614N201 with the 1-for-3 reverse stock split effective June 24, 2026, so the row is found under the new CUSIP; CalPERS's separate Qnity Electronics row is not counted. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the Q3 2026 10-Q cover count at October 30, 2026 (post-split), the same count used in the marketcap lens.
